title: Talent continuity and skill-banking manual
author: Aisha Raman
body:
Overview

This page defines Redwood's Talent Continuity & Skill-Banking program — a formalized approach to make internal mobility, short-term rotations, and capability transfers predictable, measurable, and connected to hiring/onboarding and benefits. The program balances product velocity with employee growth: it reduces single-point-of-failure skill gaps, accelerates cross-functional knowledge transfer, and ties learning incentives to operational readiness.

Principles
- Employees should be able to grow laterally and vertically without creating coverage regressions.
- Skills are a company asset: we catalog, protect, and circulate them via a credit system.
- Mobility should be low-friction for managers and safe for product SLOs.
- Learning is supported with time, stipend, and measurable outcomes.

Scope and definitions
- Skill Bank: a ledger of transferable capability credits tied to individuals and teams.
- Micro-rotation: temporary assignment (2–12 weeks) to another team or role.
- Skill Deposit: documented transfer where an individual trains a backup and records outcomes.
- Credit: unit representing one week of focused transfer or mentorship activity.

Program goals (first 12 months)
- 40% of engineering org to participate in at least one micro-rotation.
- Reduce time-to-coverage for critical services by 20%.
- Increase internal hire-to-promotion velocity by 15%.

How the Skill Bank works (high level)
- Each team maintains a coverage map in the Team Vault (Confluence template linked below).
- When someone performs a Skill Deposit (e.g., trains a backup, creates runbooks, records knowledge sessions), they earn credits into their personal Skill Bank.
- Credits can be redeemed for Micro-Rotations, Coach Hours, or Learning Stipend top-ups.
- Credits expire after 24 months unless used for an approved role change.

Credit conversion table
| Activity | Credits earned | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| One 1-hour recorded knowledge session (with slides + quick quiz) | 0.25 | min: 4 sessions for 1 credit |
| One week of paired handoff/mentoring to backfill a role | 1 | full-week equivalent |
| Creating a complete runbook + automated checks | 2 | includes runbook review by owner |
| Delivering a 2-day skills workshop | 1.5 | workshop materials must be published |

Eligibility and roles
- Eligible employees: full-time Redwood employees and long-term contractors (>6 months).
- Managers: approve Skill Deposit and short rotations, ensure coverage.
- People Ops (program team): adjudicate disputes, audit credits, run reporting.
- Team SRE/Lead: confirm technical readiness and production safety before rotations.

Procedure: Deposit skills (step-by-step)
1. Create a Team Coverage Map in the Team Vault page (use template: "Team Coverage & Skill Map").
2. Run a 1-hour transfer session and record it to the Team Library. Attach slides, outcomes, and a two-question quiz.
3. Submit a Skill Deposit form in the People Portal (Tools -> Talent -> Skill Bank -> New Deposit).
4. Manager approves (2 business days). If manager escalation is needed, People Ops routes to the program owner.
5. People Ops issues credits to the employee’s Skill Bank profile within 5 business days.

Procedure: Redeem credits for a micro-rotation
1. Employee and receiving manager propose a Rotation Request (duration, goals, coverage plan) in the Rotation Tracker (Google Sheet -- linked in template).
2. Home manager confirms coverage plan and signs off.
3. Receiving manager confirms onboarding checklist and expected deliverables.
4. People Ops validates credits and authorizes stipend (if requested).
5. Rotation runs; receiving manager files a Rotation Close Report with outcomes and knowledge artifacts.
6. People Ops reconciles credits and publishes participation metrics monthly.

Onboarding & hiring tie-ins
- New hires: during the first 90 days, every new hire completes a "Role Intake" that populates the Team Coverage Map and suggests 1–2 potential micro-rotation mentors. This is part of the Day-30 and Day-90 checklists in the New Hire Playbook.
- Backfills: when hiring externally for an open role, the hiring manager is required to assess internal Skill Bank balances and post the role internally for 3 business days.

Benefits and perks alignment
- Learning stipend top-up: redeem 5 credits to request an additional $500 learning stipend for a course or conference.
- Paid rotation time: micro-rotations of up to 4 weeks are paid at base salary; rotations beyond 4 weeks are approved case-by-case.
- Sabbatical acceleration: employees who accumulate 40 credits over 3 years are eligible for an additional 2-week sabbatical (subject to manager approval and coverage plan).

Tools and artifacts (where things live)
- Team Vault (Confluence): Team Coverage Map template, runbooks, Rotation Close Report template.
- People Portal: Skill Bank profile, deposit/redeem UI, credit ledger.
- Rotation Tracker (Google Sheet): lanes for requests, approvals, and schedule.
- Onboarding Playbook: Day-0/7/30/90 checklists that link to Role Intake.
- HR systems: Workday (comp approvals), Lever (external role posting), Okta (access).

Operational metrics and reporting
- Monthly dashboard (People Ops): participation rate, credits issued/redeemed, average rotation length, time-to-coverage for critical roles.
- Success thresholds: 25% monthly redemption rate, <10% rotations that require emergency rollback.
- Quarterly review: People Ops + Eng Leadership review program KPIs and make adjustments.

Ownership and escalation
- Program owner: People Ops (Talent Programs) — Aisha Raman (primary contact).
- Escalation path: manager -> People Ops program lead -> VP People. Emergency technical rollback: SRE lead -> Eng VP.

Implementation roadmap (next 6 months)
1. Q1 (weeks 1–6): Launch pilot with Infrastructure and Core API teams. Deliver Team Vault templates and People Portal form. Owner: Aisha Raman.
2. Q1 (weeks 7–12): Pilot eval, adjust credit rules, build Rotation Tracker automations. Owner: Program Analyst (People Ops).
3. Q2 (weeks 13–20): Company-wide launch, integrate stipend redemption into People Portal.
4. Q2–Q3: Add Skill Bank export to People Ops BI and schedule quarterly reviews with Eng leadership.

Sample templates and examples
- Rotation length -> credit redemption guidance:
| Rotation length | Credits required (min) | Recommended approval |
|---|---:|---|
| 2 weeks | 2 | Home manager + receiving manager |
| 4 weeks | 4 | Home manager + receiving manager + People Ops |
| 8–12 weeks | 8–12 | Full leadership review + SRE sign-off |

FAQs (short)
Q: Can I sell my credits or transfer them to another person?
A: Credits are non-transferable except in approved mentorship swaps documented in the People Portal.

Q: What happens if coverage fails mid-rotation?
A: Receiving manager triggers the emergency coverage runbook; SRE or team lead executes rollback steps. People Ops records the incident and may suspend future rotation privileges until remediation.

Appendices
- Templates: Team Coverage & Skill Map, Rotation Request, Rotation Close Report (links in Team Vault).
- Audit cadence: People Ops audits 10% of Skill Deposits monthly for fidelity.

Contact and next steps
- Questions or to propose a pilot: contact Aisha Raman (People Ops) or open a ticket via internal People Portal (Category: Talent Programs -> Skill Bank).
- Launch notes: pilot kickoff deck and timeline are attached to this Confluence page.

Revision history
- 2025-11-15: First draft (A. Raman).
- 2026-01-12: Updated credit conversions and benefits tie-ins after pilot feedback.
- 2026-02-10: Published with company-wide rollout schedule.
